title: Declassified CIA memos on exotic gravity research at universities

tellings.quote: And you go back to these declassified CIA memos and you're like the outpost for exotic gravity research.

plain: In the 1950s, declassified CIA memos show American universities working as outposts for what Jesse Michels calls "exotic gravity research". The places tied to the story are Indiana, Purdue, Princeton and MIT. Michels says this himself, in a conversation about UFO physics, pointing to the memos without quoting them, as a sign that the government took unusual gravity science seriously early on.
